text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky and I are going home after a
day out
when we somehow get lost.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Umm, did I majorly mess up? I'm not sure
how to
get back to a road I know!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe we ended up in this
trouble just
because I tried to take a
detour!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer! There's a better way to
get out of a
situation like this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Sorry to bother you, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After asking for directions at the police
box, we
make it back to familiar ground.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, that settles that! I'm so glad I
asked the
officer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I hear you can easily look up a map
using your
phone, but it's better to ask
someone, don't you
think?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It also lets me stay true to what my
father taught
me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
He said there's no shame in asking for
help when
you need it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No matter how great you are, you can't
do
everything by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you try to handle all your problems
alone, you
might get stuck...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So to avoid that, make it a point to
connect with
others. That's what he told
me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it? It makes me happy to hear you
say so.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about relying on someone or
having
them rely on you, it's about
supporting each
other...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I hope we can have that kind of
relationship too.
